art_style: Flat technical diagram, heavy strokes, one-color silhouette

Abstract mark.reason: A simple geometric contour fits the GitHub avatar and can point back to a real 3D operation.

Lettermark.reason: A single readable letter can work at 32 px and tie the icon back to the exact agent name.

Mascot.reason: A character would compete with the mesh story and increase the chance of an unrelated pop-culture reading.

concepts.art_style: Flat technical diagram with wide negative space
concepts.example: Draw two solid offset profiles with one open vertical break, keeping the outside silhouette continuous in a 32 px circle crop.
concepts.rationale: The opening evokes reading a cross-section, the gap makes the object easy to parse, and the two intact profiles suggest inspecting and refining a shape while preserving the input. The break must stay visible at 16 px.

concepts.art_style: Cut-paper lettering with a single precise joint
concepts.example: Form a compact B from two squared counters with a small seam where the panels meet, using the seam as the only detail.
concepts.rationale: The B points to BART, the two panels suggest adjoining mesh faces, and the visible seam expresses a deliberate refinement. The counters may fill at favicon size.

concepts.example: Place a stepped solid shape inside an open corner frame, with the margin supplying the second edge instead of drawing a full border.
concepts.rationale: The frame refers to reported bounds, the visible placement helps a new user understand scale, and the open corner leaves room for iteration. It could read as a crop icon without a distinctive interior.

selection_reason: Trial recommendation at 90/100. The contour and opening carry the concept at avatar size using one color. Awaiting owner review.
